name: Salesforge
tagline: Multi-channel cold outreach with an autonomous AI SDR.
description: An outbound sales platform for cold email and LinkedIn that bundles unlimited mailboxes, deliverability tooling, and reply management. Its flagship AI SDR, Agent Frank, finds prospects, writes and personalizes outreach, runs follow-ups, and books meetings in auto-pilot or co-pilot mode.
insight: Part of a 'Forge' GTM suite alongside Mailforge (mailboxes), Leadsforge (lead data), and the Agent Frank AI SDR.
edge: Pairs unlimited mailboxes and deliverability tooling with an autonomous AI SDR, so prospecting and sending live in one platform.
cons: Reply quality reportedly weaker than top-of-funnel
